heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: Can a BBA student do ACCA?
a: Yes. And at ATLAS ISME, it's built right into the degree. The BBA / BBA (Hons.) in International Accounting & Finance with ACCA is a 4-year integrated program designed to align seamlessly with the ACCA curriculum. Students can earn up to 9 paper exemptions (covering the Applied Knowledge and Applied Skills levels, F1–F9) alongside their BBA degree, giving them a significant head start on the full ACCA qualification.

items.q: What is the salary after BBA ACCA?
a: The website does not specify salary figures. However, graduates are positioned for high-trajectory roles such as Investment Banking Analyst, International Tax Consultant, Financial Controller and Big 4 Auditor, all of which command strong compensation, particularly with the ACCA qualification adding global credibility.

items.q: What are the subjects in BBA with ACCA?
a: The curriculum spans 8 semesters and includes Financial Accounting, Financial Reporting (IFRS), Financial Management, Corporate Finance, Investment Analysis & Portfolio Management, Audit & Assurance, Indian Taxation Laws, International Taxation, Advanced Financial Management (AFM), Advanced Performance Management (APM), Advanced Taxation (ATX), Advanced Audit & Assurance (AAA), Corporate Valuation, Investment Banking Fundamentals, Strategic Business Leadership (SBL), International Finance, Behavioural Finance, Entrepreneurial Finance and a Research Dissertation, alongside core business subjects and electives.

items.q: What are the career options after BBA International Accounting & Finance with ACCA?
a: Graduates can pursue roles across six broad tracks: Global Audit & Assurance (Statutory Auditor, Forensic Accountant, Risk Assurance at Big 4 firms), Corporate Finance & Investment Banking (M&A Analyst, Portfolio Analyst, PE Analyst), Taxation & Legal Advisory (International Tax Consultant, GST Expert, Transfer Pricing Specialist), Management Accounting & Strategy (FP&A Manager, Business Finance Partner), Financial Reporting & Control (Financial Controller, CFO Pathway, IFRS Expert) and Entrepreneurship & Consultancy (FinTech Founder, Wealth Advisor, Business Consultant).

items.q: What is BBA in International Finance?
a: At ATLAS ISME, BBA International Accounting & Finance with ACCA is an integrated undergraduate degree that combines a full BBA education with ACCA-aligned coursework covering global financial reporting (IFRS), international taxation, cross-border finance strategies and advanced financial management, preparing students for careers in global financial markets and multinational corporations.

items.q: Is ACCA better than CA for an international career?
a: ACCA is recognised in over 180 countries, making it a stronger credential for those targeting international careers in global accounting, audit or finance. CA (India) is highly respected domestically but has more limited global portability. For students aspiring to work with multinational firms, Big 4 offices abroad or international financial institutions, ACCA is generally the preferred qualification and the ATLAS ISME program is designed specifically with this global career pathway in mind.

items.q: Who should choose BBA with ACCA over a regular BBA in Finance?
a: This program is ideal for students who want a globally recognised professional accounting qualification alongside their degree, aspire to work with Big 4 firms or multinational corporations, are targeting international careers in audit, taxation or financial reporting or want to fast-track their ACCA journey with up to 9 paper exemptions built into the curriculum. A regular BBA in Finance is broader and better suited for those interested in investment, markets or general business, not a professional accounting qualification.

items.q: Can I do an MBA after a BBA in International Accounting & Finance with ACCA?
a: Yes. Graduates holding a BBA with at least 50% aggregate from a university recognised by the AIU are eligible to apply for ATLAS ISME's MBA programs. Options include MBA in FinTech, MBA in Investment Banking, MBA in Financial Planning & Applied Finance and the MBA for an AI World, all of which can build naturally on the strong finance foundation this program provides.
